value.title: PHI: Architectural Support for Synchronization- and Bandwidth-Efficient Commutative Scatter Updates
value.edition: 14-page MICRO2019 author proceedings PDF;DOI10.1145/3352460.3358254 andofficial author provenance verified
value.locator_basis: 1-based PDF pages,printed MICRO52 footer;cached primary hash in separate provenance

value.statement: Cache lines marked as buffered updates contain identity-initialized partial reductions rather than fetched original data. Per-level ALU coalesces updates on hits.
limitations: Paper specification only;actual instruction/ALU/coherence/flush/bin source and numeric legality need binding.

value.statement: LLC evictions choose in-place apply versus tagged update-bin streaming based on nonidentity element density;the threshold is derived from update/index byte sizes. Replay disables further batching and applies bin updates.
limitations: Paper specification only;actual instruction/ALU/coherence/flush/bin source and numeric legality need binding.

value.statement: Software configures operation and bin starting addresses,then uses a push-update instruction with destination address and value source operands. CPU computes index/address;configuration uses memory-mapped registers.
limitations: Paper specification only;actual instruction/ALU/coherence/flush/bin source and numeric legality need binding.

value.statement: Buffered private partial lines are outside ordinary coherence and flush to shared banks. Bulk updates require relaxed-atomic annotation and phi_sync before reads;PHI does not transparently gather private partials for intervening reads. Mixing conventional atomics with PHI updates to the updated region is outside the stated discipline.
limitations: Paper specification only;actual instruction/ALU/coherence/flush/bin source and numeric legality need binding.

value.statement: The examined batching implementation requires contiguous physical update storage to derive index from physical address. Bin chunks/pointers are physical,cache-bank-striped,and full chunks interrupt allocation with batching disabled temporarily. Paging out requires disabling batching.
limitations: Paper specification only;actual instruction/ALU/coherence/flush/bin source and numeric legality need binding.

value.statement: Evaluated PageRank/PageRankDelta/SpMV use8-byte double add;integer min/add examples use4-byte objects and radii uses8-byte bitwiseOR. Exact integer signedness and full ISA type/width ABI are not specified by table alone.
limitations: Paper specification only;actual instruction/ALU/coherence/flush/bin source and numeric legality need binding.

value.description: Explicit bulk commutative scatter-update interface with hierarchy coalescing,selective bins andflush;no generic gather capability.

value.name: PHI MICRO2019 bulk relaxed-atomic scatter update
value.summary: Hierarchical partial-update buffering/ALUs with selective LLC binning and explicit visibility phase.

interface.software_supplies: Commutative operation/identity,update address/value stream,bins/data physicalmapping andbulk phase boundaries.
interface.invocation: Configuration registers pluspush-updateinstruction;framework disables batching/replays bins andcalls phi_sync.

realization.description: Configure operation/bin storage,push commutative address/value updates,disable batching and replay bins,flush private partial lines andsynchronize before CPU reads.

result.form: Deferred update of destination memory;ordinary read after required synchronization obtains final merged data.
result.validity: Bulk relaxed-atomic commutative semantics,no intervening reads,correct algebra/identity/numeric legality,actual physical/bin/flush proofs.

ordering.description: Coalescing and batching may change update order;does not grant bit-exact IEEE source-order equality,reassociation permission or arbitrary atomic/CAS substitution.

completion.event: All bins replayed with batching disabled and phi_sync/privateflush completed before destination reads.
completion.visibility: Ordinary coherence retained for other data;shared buffered line reads merge residualpartials in-place.

requirements.description: No destination reads during ingest/replay;explicit relaxed-atomic annotation required. Do not mix conventional atomics on the updated region.
Prove replay completion,private partialflush,phi_sync andshared readmerge visibility.
Contiguous physical destination storage andbank-local striped bins/chunks;disable batching before paging andrefill.
Prove reduction/reordering is legal under unchanged original oracle;identity,NaN, signed zero,overflow androunding constraints not discharged.
Mapping must not need returned priorvalue,CASsuccess orimmediate nonatomicvisibility.
Exact opcode/ALU/bin/flush implementation source/model must be authenticated.

parameters.notes: Evaluated cacheline reference;not universal index/operand ABI.

internal_mechanisms.description: Identity-initialized partial lines withbuffered-update tag coexist withordinary coherent data.
Private/sharedcache ALU combines updates byword offset without fetching original data first.
LLC eviction either applies in-place orstreams index/value updates tobins based on density;replay phase disables rebatching.
Relaxed-atomic domain forbidsinterveningreads untilbinsandprivate partials areflushed.
LLCbanks independentlyupdate bank-local binpointers/partial lines;fullchunkinterrupt temporarily disablesbatching.
Explicitphi_sync flushesprivate partials;shared readmerges remaininglinepartial before returning data.

limitations: Examined bulk commutative update operation,not ordinaryBFSparentCAS/defaultgather.
No current source/RTL/model identity,FP bitwise equivalence,performance orcompatibility acceptance.
The no-intervening-read/flush/physical contiguity requirements are stronger than genericgraph workload labels.
